title: JSON Canvas with the Canvas Shapes extensions (format version 1)
description: A JSON Canvas 1.0 file whose root, nodes and edges may carry a `canvasShapes` object. See FORMAT.md. Keys inside `canvasShapes` that this version does not define are allowed, so newer files stay valid for older readers.

canvasExtension.description: Root marker: the version of the extensions format the file was written with.

shape.description: Outline of the card. Defaults to rectangle; ignored on groups.

width.description: Line width in pixels. Defaults to 2.
